TC-25/S22.title: Android app (debug build on the local stack) and desktop Chrome: steps 2-5 in both modes
TC-25/S22.detail: Android rig: debug build of main e02167f bundled for the LOCAL stack only (bundle names 127.0.0.1:4510/4511, reached through adb reverse), built outside the checkout, on the rc_api36 emulator (Pixel 7, Android 16); Playwright attached to the app's own WebView; every ai/* action the app sends is answered or failed at the WebView's socket (no model call; aiCallLog had no new row in any run). Phone = the app, signed in through its own email-code form (POST 200, its own session); computer = desktop Chromium with a separate session, Hospital (S01 loop) and Nursing Home (S02 loop). T3 (TFA-92570, judged): own-form sign-in, an add made in the app is stored and listed like a web add, the computer's pre-round save reaches the app's chart the same way it reaches a second web session, Generate in the app (scripted note) stores and shows the note, and a delete on the computer removes the patient for the app: Hospital 8/8, Nursing Home 6/6 judged checks (no resident delete control exists on web or app: known B24 / Q3). Recorded only (U1-U6, gated TFA-94513 in progress / TFA-94704 backlog): the computer stayed signed in after the phone's sign-in; the phone's add showed on the computer without a refresh (3 ms / 309 ms); the phone's note showed on the computer's Post-Round without a refresh; the delete reached the phone in 322 ms; Nursing Home pre-round text and BP showed live on the phone. Hospital: the computer's saved pre-round TEXT did not appear on the app's open chart (nor on a second web session; the panel BP did, in ~0.3 s) until the chart was reopened, and a follow-up probe (dvc-tc25-s22-probe-stale-preround) showed that typing into that stale empty box on the phone replaced the computer's saved note on the server (see newFindings). Note: the 01:46 run's tripwire line 'FORBIDDEN notes.generateNote +16' came from the old count-based tripwire reading a partial table at mark time; aiCallLog had no row newer than 09:00:54Z at all (checked), and the tripwire is now time-based.
